nodes.label: Login and auth flow repair
nodes.rationale: The app had no sign-in screen and Auth0 silently drops offline_access unless API and app grant switches are on.

nodes.label: AuthProvider / AuthGate / useAccessToken
nodes.rationale: RENEW_FAILED is not terminal because iOS reports an unreachable token endpoint like a revoked refresh token, and treating it as terminal would delete a working refresh token.
